section3.title: 3. AI-Powered Features and Data Processing

Text returned by OCR is scrubbed again before it reaches a language model.

automated_processing.title: Automated Processing & Decision-Making:

You retain full discretion to review, edit, override, or delete any record, or disable AI processing entirely in your account.

data_retention.title: Data Retention:

user_control.description: You can switch AI off under Profile → Preferences. While it is off, receipt scanning, voice input, tips, insights and predictions are disabled and no data is sent to any AI provider.

no_personal_data.title: No Personal Data:
no_personal_data.description: We never send your name, e-mail address, account identifiers, IBANs, card numbers, phone numbers or postal addresses to an AI model.

refund.after_2: You keep all the features of your plan until the last day of the period you already paid for (the month or the year).
refund.after_3: After that day your account moves to the Free plan. Your records stay in your account, and the limits of the Free plan apply.
refund.after_4: Cancelling does not delete your account. You can delete your account and data separately at any time.
refund.rules_desc: The money for a billing period that has already started is not refunded, for monthly and yearly plans alike. We make these exceptions:
refund.rules_yes_1: You were charged twice for the same period, or the amount is higher than the price shown when you subscribed.
refund.rules_yes_2: You were charged after you cancelled on time, or the charge was not made by you.
refund.rules_yes_3: A problem on our side kept you from using the paid features and we could not fix it.
refund.rules_yes_4: Peruvian consumer law gives you the right to a refund in your case.
refund.rules_window: Please write to us within 7 days of the charge. If you write later, we will still read your request and review it, but we cannot promise a refund.
refund.rules_no_1: A month or a year that you have already started and simply did not use.
refund.rules_no_2: A renewal you forgot to cancel before the renewal date, unless one of the cases above applies.
refund.yearly_desc: If you cancel a yearly plan, it does not renew and you keep your features until the end of the year you paid for. The remaining months are not refunded, unless one of the cases in section 3 applies.
refund.how_title: 5. How to ask for a refund
refund.how_desc: Write to info@kaptia.app from the email of your account and tell us:
refund.how_1: the date and the amount of the charge,
refund.how_2: how you paid (Stripe or Mercado Pago),
refund.how_3: why you are asking for the refund.
refund.how_after: We answer within 5 business days. If we approve it, we return the money to the same payment method you used. Depending on the payment company and your card, it can take up to 10 business days to appear.
refund.law_desc: This policy does not take away any right that the Peruvian Consumer Protection and Defense Code gives you. If you do not agree with our answer, you can file a claim in our Complaints Book, or go to INDECOPI.
refund.contact_desc: Questions about cancelling or refunds: info@kaptia.app.
